## Why

K2 §3.3 fixes the entity URL scheme — `/entity/<type>/<name-slug>--<hash7>/`
with the **hash authoritative and frozen** and the slug cosmetic — and
§6.5 the append-only record every issued key lives in. The history is
the input the single redirect generator (JUR-05, **P36.35**) consumes:
it must answer rename 301 / split 300 / withdrawal 410 / `/id/` to the
current URL without ever re-deriving identity. P35.29 (ADR-215) landed
the shared label/slug/hash primitives and left this artifact and the
`/id/` semantics to this row.

## What lands

- **`policy/src/policy/slug_history.py`** — `sig.slug-history/1`, the
  history half of the one identifier module:
  - `merge_history` — the append-only release merge. Prior rows carry
    **verbatim** (a diff of the emitted row lists verifies
    append-only); a key's retirement is an *appended* terminal row
    naming the same `(uuid, hash, url_type, slug)` — `renamed` 301,
    `merged` 301 to the survivor, `split` 300 with the successor list,
    `withdrawn` 410 — so liveness is **computed** (`current` minus
    retired), never the row's status alone. A recorded terminal
    entity with no visible prior key emits `slug: null` — recorded,
    never fabricated. A `person` entity emits nothing. A
    **publication-withdrawn** entity (P34.19/F-337) is scrubbed
    entirely — every row naming its id leaves the document, no
    tombstone, and withdrawn ids are filtered out of merge/split
    targets — while an unexplained absence still earns the honest K2
    `withdrawn` 410.
  - `freeze_hashes` — the K2 collision rule: "already issued" means
    issued **to a different uuid** (a label reusing its own hash is
    the permanence contract, not a collision); a foreign or sibling
    collision extends the *new* key one base32 character at a time in
    deterministic sorted-id order — never rewrites an issued hash.
  - `check_unique_labels` — the SIG-UI-111 backstop: a duplicate full
    display label within `(kind, release)` refuses the export.
  - `resolve_request` — the single redirect vocabulary (the reference
    the JUR-05 generator consumes): `/entity/<type>/<anything>--<hash>/`
    resolves hash-authoritative (exact key serves 200; wrong slug 301s
    canonical; retired key answers its terminal status) and
    `/id/<type>/<uuid>` answers **302** to the current key while live
    (the target is movable — a cached 301 would strand the permanent
    identifier), else the terminal status, else the honest 404.
  - `history_doc` — the emitted document (`schema`, `publication`,
    `generated_at`, `rows` sorted `(uuid, hash, from_pub, status)` for
    byte-stable output); refuses a registry with two live keys per
    uuid, a key retired twice, or a `person` row.
- **`exports/src/exports/spine_export.py`** — `build_spine_export` /
  `run_spine_export` take `previous_entity_history` (the release-chain
  binding; absent = the honest first-release posture), freeze the label
  registry's hashes against it, run the SIG-UI-111 check, and emit
  `web/entity_slug_history.json` (`sig.slug-history/1`) into the web
  compartment with licence + counts on the manifest.
- **`web/src/lib/entity-history.ts`** — `resolveEntityRequest`, the
  TypeScript mirror of `resolve_request` (same regexes, same liveness
  rule, same status map — the vocabulary a generated redirect rule and
  the fixture page can never diverge over) plus the committed fixtures
  document exercising every status.
- **`web/src/lib/data.ts`** — `getEntitySlugHistory()`: export mode
  reads `<exportDir>/web/entity_slug_history.json` (absent = honest
  empty history); fixtures mode serves the committed fixture doc.
- **`docs/adr/ADR-227-…md`** — records the owned decisions: verbatim
  carry + computed liveness, the `/id/` 302, foreign-uuid collision
  extension, `slug: null` honesty, SIG-UI-111 as ship blocker, the
  artifact home, the two-mirror vocabulary, and the
  publication-withdrawal scrub vs the lifecycle tombstone.

## Tests

- `tests/unit/test_policy_slug_history.py` (**39**) — issued/frozen
  hash semantics (own hash reused, foreign collision extended, never
  rewritten); verbatim carry + appended transitions (rename keeps
  uuid+hash; merge/split/withdrawal terminal rows; terminal keys never
  reopen); publication-withdrawal scrub (rows gone entirely, `/id/`
  honest 404 — not even the id); recorded-terminal `slug: null`;
  person suppression; `history_doc` refusal cases; the full
  `resolve_request` matrix (200/301-canonical/301-renamed/301-merged/
  300/410/302-`/id/`/404).
- `tests/exports/test_entity_slug_history.py` (**8**) — the artifact
  through `build_spine_export`: schema + publication binding + current
  rows; person/unlabelled emit nothing; merged tombstone to survivor;
  prior history verbatim + appended rename; cross-release stability;
  SIG-UI-111 distinct keys + the refusal backstop.
- `web/tests/unit/entity-history.test.ts` (**18**) — the TypeScript
  mirror over the fixture doc: every `/entity/` and `/id/` semantic
  incl. the stale-current merged `/id/` (the verbatim-carried
  `current` row never wins) + `getEntitySlugHistory` data-source legs.
- Regression repaired in-flight: `tests/exports/test_p34_19_express_terms.py`
  `test_withdrawn_claim_leaves_every_public_artifact` caught the first
  cut tombstoning publication-withdrawn ids — the scrub semantics are
  now tested, ADR-227 point 8.
